source: MASSIVE 1.1 en-US (official tar, 16521 rows: 11514 train / 2033 dev / 2974 test)
extra_rule: calendar_set rows whose utt contains 'remind' -> timers_reminders
notes: other = send to LLM (includes general_* chat, calendar, email, iot, weather, news, qa_factoid, datetime_convert, music_settings, etc.)
doc_qa has no MASSIVE rows; examples come only from own-phrasing set (T-06)
timers, unit conversion, music transport (pause/next) are almost absent in MASSIVE; covered by T-06
datetime_convert is mostly time zones; clock skill has no time-zone support, so it stays in other
most MASSIVE reminder phrasing is labeled calendar_set, hence the extra rule
